title: 웃으면서
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Rock with a driving pop-punk influence. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted eighth notes in the verses and open power chords in the chorus. A clean electric guitar provides melodic counterpoint with bright, arpeggiated riffs. The bass guitar follows the kick drum with a consistent eighth-note pulse. Drums feature a standard rock kit with a prominent snare on 2 and 4 and active hi-hat patterns. Male vocals are delivered in a clear, melodic tenor range with slight grit during high-energy transitions. The arrangement is dense with layered vocal harmonies in the chorus. Key of E Major, 135 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, driving rock drums]

[Verse 1]
[palm-muted electric guitar, bass pulse]
사랑이 끝나는 순간에도 이유를 찾았어
왜 떠나는지 널 이해시키려 했어 [clean arpeggiated guitar enters]
전제가 틀렸다면 결론도 바뀔 수 있잖아
밤새 증명하려 했어 우리가 맞다는 걸

[Pre-Chorus]
[drums build with snare rolls, guitar distortion increases]
만난 날짜를 적었어
좋았던 순간을 적었어
수식처럼 풀려고 했어
